en: The postcard features a monochrome photograph of an elegant, spacious interior foyer. The room has a large window, ornamental ceiling, staircase, double doors, potted palm plants, an armchair, and a richly patterned rug, evoking an early to mid-20th century European style. The reverse side provides printed text indicating the place, along with stamps, cataloguing markings, and a museum logo.
